controls.guidance: Review capacity monitoring dashboards, thresholds, alerts and capacity plans. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Capacity management is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where capacity management affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.description: Systems are protected against malware, backed by user awareness.
controls.guidance: Check anti-malware coverage and update status across endpoints and servers, and review detections and responses. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Protection against malware is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where protection against malware affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: The organization learns of technical vulnerabilities in its systems, assesses its exposure, and takes timely action.
controls.guidance: Review scanning coverage and results, patching timelines against defined targets, and handling of exceptions. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Management of technical vulnerabilities is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where management of technical vulnerabilities affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.description: Secure configurations for hardware, software, services and networks are defined, applied, monitored and reviewed.
controls.guidance: Obtain configuration baselines and test a sample of systems for drift; review change records for configuration updates. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Configuration management is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where configuration management affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.description: Information that is no longer needed is deleted from systems, devices and storage.
controls.guidance: Check deletion procedures and retention-driven deletion jobs, and sample systems for data kept beyond its retention period. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Information deletion is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Customer PII is securely deleted when the customer requests it or the contract ends, including from backups within a defined period.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.description: Data masking hides sensitive data, such as personal data, where policy, law or business need requires it.
controls.guidance: Review where masking, tokenization or pseudonymization is applied, for example in test environments and reports, and test whether it works. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Data masking is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where data masking affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.description: Measures detect and prevent unauthorized leakage of sensitive information from systems, networks and devices.
controls.guidance: Review DLP tooling and rules, monitored channels, alerts raised and how they were handled. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Data leakage prevention is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where data leakage prevention affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.description: Backups of information, software and systems are taken and tested in line with an agreed backup policy.
controls.guidance: Check backup schedules and success logs, offsite or immutable copies, and recent restore test results. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Information backup is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Backups of customer PII are protected and restoration of customer PII is logged.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Systems are built with enough redundancy to meet availability requirements.
controls.guidance: Review architecture diagrams for single points of failure and evidence of failover testing for critical services. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Redundancy of information processing facilities is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where redundancy of information processing facilities affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Logs of activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events are produced, kept, protected and analysed.
controls.guidance: Check log sources, retention, protection against tampering, and evidence of log review or SIEM use. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Logging is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Logs record access to and changes of customer PII and are protected and retained for a defined period.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications are watched for abnormal behaviour, and potential incidents are acted on.
controls.guidance: Review monitoring coverage, alert rules, on-call arrangements and a sample of alerts with their response. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Monitoring activities is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where monitoring activities affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.description: System clocks are synchronized to approved time sources so that logs and events line up.
controls.guidance: Check NTP configuration on a sample of systems and the approved time sources. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Clock synchronization is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where clock synchronization affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: Utility programs that can bypass system or application controls are restricted and tightly controlled.
controls.guidance: Identify powerful utilities in use, check who can run them, and review logging of their use. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Use of privileged utility programs is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where use of privileged utility programs affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Software installation on operational systems is controlled.
controls.guidance: Review installation rights, allow-listing or software deployment controls, and sample installed software against approved lists. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Installation of software on operational systems is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where installation of software on operational systems affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.description: Networks and network devices are secured, managed and controlled to protect the information on systems and applications.
controls.guidance: Review network diagrams, device hardening, administrative access to network devices, and firewall rule reviews. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Networks security is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where networks security affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and requirements for network services are identified, put in place and monitored.
controls.guidance: Check network service agreements and security features (for example encryption, DDoS protection) and monitoring of provider performance. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Security of network services is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where security of network services affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users and systems are separated into different network segments.
controls.guidance: Review segmentation design and test that controls between segments, such as firewall rules or VLANs, enforce the intended separation. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Segregation of networks is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where segregation of networks affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites is managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.
controls.guidance: Review web filtering tooling, blocked categories and exception handling, and test coverage for remote users. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Web filtering is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where web filtering affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.description: Rules for using cryptography, including managing keys, are defined and put into practice.
controls.guidance: Obtain the cryptography policy and key management procedures and check encryption in transit and at rest for key systems. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Use of cryptography is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Customer PII transmitted over public networks is encrypted.

controls.title: Secure development lifecycle
controls.description: Rules for developing software and systems securely are set and followed throughout the development life cycle.
controls.guidance: Review the secure SDLC standard and sample projects for security activities at each phase. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Secure development lifecycle is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where secure development lifecycle affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.description: Security requirements are identified, specified and approved when building or buying applications.
controls.guidance: Sample application projects or purchases for documented security requirements and their approval. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Application security requirements is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where application security requirements affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.description: Principles for designing secure systems are defined, documented, kept current and applied to all system development.
controls.guidance: Check for documented secure architecture principles and evidence they were applied in recent design reviews. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Secure system architecture and engineering principles is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where secure system architecture and engineering principles affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.description: Secure coding practices are applied to software development.
controls.guidance: Review coding standards, developer training, code review records and static analysis results. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Secure coding is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where secure coding affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Security testing is defined and carried out during development and before systems are accepted into use.
controls.guidance: Look for security test plans and results (for example SAST, DAST, penetration tests) and acceptance criteria tied to them. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Security testing in development and acceptance is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where security testing in development and acceptance affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.description: The organization directs, monitors and reviews outsourced development work.
controls.guidance: Review outsourced development contracts for security requirements, and evidence of oversight such as code reviews or acceptance testing. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Outsourced development is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where outsourced development affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.description: Development, test and production environments are kept separate and secured.
controls.guidance: Check environment separation, access differences between environments and controls on promotion to production. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Separation of development, test and production environments is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where separation of development, test and production environments affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and systems go through change management.
controls.guidance: Sample changes for request, impact assessment, approval, testing and post-implementation review. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Change management is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where change management affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Test information
controls.description: Information used for testing is chosen carefully and protected.
controls.guidance: Check whether production data is used in test, and if so how it is approved, masked and removed after use. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Test information is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where test information affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.description: Audits and other assurance tests on operational systems are planned and agreed between the tester and management to limit disruption.
controls.guidance: Review audit or testing plans for agreed scope, timing, access restrictions and approval from system owners. For a public cloud PII processor, check how the control protects customer PII.
objectives: Protection of information systems during audit testing is implemented for the public cloud service in scope.
Where protection of information systems during audit testing affects customer PII, the protection it gives to PII processed for cloud service customers is documented.

controls.title: Processing only on customer instructions
controls.description: Customer PII is processed only for the purposes and on the documented instructions of the cloud service customer.
controls.guidance: Review the contract and data processing terms, how instructions are captured, and how the organization refuses or flags instructions that would break the law.
objectives: Customer PII is processed only for purposes set out in the contract and on the customer's documented instructions.
The customer is told when an instruction appears to infringe applicable law.

controls.title: No marketing use of customer PII
controls.description: Customer PII is not used for marketing or advertising without the customer's express consent, and consent is never a condition of using the service.
controls.guidance: Check policies and technical controls that prevent secondary use of customer PII, and any consent records.
objectives: Customer PII is not used for marketing or advertising without express consent.
Use of the service does not depend on consent to marketing use.

controls.title: Temporary files
controls.description: Temporary files and documents containing customer PII are deleted within a defined period.
controls.guidance: Look for a defined retention period for temporary files, automated cleanup and checks that it works.
objectives: Temporary files containing customer PII are erased within a defined, documented period.

controls.title: Legally binding disclosure requests
controls.description: The cloud service customer is told of legally binding requests to disclose its PII unless the law prohibits it, and requests that are not legally binding are rejected.
controls.guidance: Review the law enforcement request procedure, notification records and the register of requests.
objectives: Legally binding disclosure requests are notified to the customer unless prohibited.
Requests that are not legally binding are rejected or referred to the customer.

controls.title: Records of disclosures
controls.description: Disclosures of customer PII to third parties are recorded, including what was disclosed, to whom and when.
controls.guidance: Check a disclosure register and the approval process for disclosures.
objectives: Every disclosure of customer PII to a third party is recorded with what, to whom and when.

controls.title: Return, transfer and disposal
controls.description: At the end of the contract customer PII is returned, transferred or securely disposed of under a policy made available to the customer.
controls.guidance: Review the exit and data return policy, deletion procedures and evidence of completed returns or deletions.
objectives: A policy on return, transfer and disposal of customer PII is made available to the customer.
Customer PII is returned or securely deleted at contract end within the agreed period.

controls.title: Disclosure of subcontracted processing
controls.description: The use of subcontractors to process customer PII is disclosed to the customer before use, with changes notified so the customer can object or terminate.
controls.guidance: Look for a published subprocessor list, change notifications and flow-down of obligations in subprocessor contracts.
objectives: Subprocessors of customer PII are disclosed to the customer before use.
Changes to subprocessors are notified with an opportunity to object.
Subprocessors are bound to equivalent PII protection obligations.

controls.title: Location of customer PII
controls.description: The countries where customer PII may be stored or processed are specified to the customer, and changes are notified in advance.
controls.guidance: Check service documentation or contracts listing processing locations, and the change notification process.
objectives: The countries where customer PII may be processed are documented and given to the customer.
Changes to processing locations are notified to the customer in advance.

controls.title: Supporting access, correction and erasure
controls.description: The organization gives the cloud service customer the means to meet requests from PII principals to access, correct or erase their PII.
controls.guidance: Review product features and support procedures for rights requests and the handling of requests received directly from PII principals.
objectives: The customer can fulfil PII principals' access, correction and erasure requests using the service or with the organization's support.
Requests received directly from PII principals are passed to the customer.

controls.title: Breach notification to the customer
controls.description: Breaches involving customer PII are notified to the cloud service customer promptly, with the information the customer needs to meet its own obligations.
controls.guidance: Review contractual notification timeframes, the breach procedure and records of notifications, including the details provided.
objectives: Breach notification terms, including timeframes, are agreed in the contract.
Notifications include the nature of the breach, likely consequences and measures taken.
A record of breaches and notifications is kept.

controls.title: Retention of security policies and records
controls.description: Copies of security policies and operating procedures are retained for a defined period after they are replaced, to support investigations and audits.
controls.guidance: Check the retention period for superseded policies and procedures and evidence they are kept.
objectives: Superseded security policies and procedures are retained for a defined period.

controls.title: Restriction of hard copy and removable media
controls.description: Creation of hard copy material and use of removable media containing customer PII is restricted, authorized and recorded.
controls.guidance: Review policy on printing and removable media for customer PII and logs of authorized use.
objectives: Hard copy and removable media containing customer PII are created only when authorized and recorded.

controls.title: Encryption and secure disposal of PII
controls.description: Customer PII is encrypted in transit over public networks and on portable media, and is securely disposed of when no longer needed.
controls.guidance: Check encryption configuration for data in transit and on portable media, and disposal records.
objectives: Customer PII sent over public networks or held on portable media is encrypted.
Customer PII is securely disposed of when no longer needed.
